title: Sunbeam Orchard Interact
text:
Sunbeam Orchard Interact

requirements_summary:
Small DTC retailer building conversational support + product search. Wants hosted API for fast time-to-value. Hard constraints: cannot allow customer prompts or transcripts to be used for model training, need retention TTL for logs (default 30 days suggested), ability for end-users to opt-out of logging, and proof of deletion for specific request IDs. Latency target: p95 < 300ms for chat turn; throughput modest (10-40 reqs/s) with burst capacity for peak sales events.

timeline:
2025-10-31: inbound signup via /signup (trial credits used).
2025-11-03: AE outreach email + calendar invite (Alex).
2025-11-04: 30m discovery call (ff_2025-11-04_01_sunbeam_intro). key ask: data retention and opt-out.
2025-11-06: security questionnaire sent (attached drive link).
2025-11-10: follow-up call requested by legal to review SLA and deletion flow.

notes:
Customer profile: mid-size ecommerce brand (home goods). Focused on conversion lift via better search + quick returns handling.
Main legal question: 'Do you store prompts? How long, and can we opt our customers out? We need a written guarantee that PII will be deleted on request.'
Alex (AE): emphasised Redwood hosted API fast onboarding and free credits for POC. Jordan (SE) demoed API flow and showed retention TTL config in Console during call.
SE notes: Redwood hosted default is not to use customer prompts for model training; can provide written attestation and config for opt-out. Need to confirm log retention windows (30/90/365 options) and if per-customer override via account settings is available.
Customer asked: 'Is there an API to delete a single request and get confirmation? Our privacy policy requires proof for deletions.'
Customer is cost sensitive but willing to pay for compliance add-on. Estimated ARR small; willing to move to Dedicated only if retention/residency needs demand it.
Suggested POC: 1) Send sample transcripts to hosted API with sandbox account; 2) validate deletion API and receive confirmation; 3) measure latency p95 on 13B quantized model or comparable curated open model.
Potential objections: legal needs KMS/HSM mention for keys. For now they accept Redwood-managed keys if deletion APIs + audit logs suffice. Ask: can you push audit logs to their Splunk?
Action items: 1) Provide short one-pager on retention and training policy (Alex). 2) SE to run quick demo of deletion API + tail logs scrub (Jordan). 3) Draft short SOC2/attestation snippet for their legal.

blockers:
clarification on log retention policy
explicit opt-out for prompt storage
legal wants deletion guarantees and SCOP for PII

next_step:
Send hosted-API retention SLA summary + sample POA; schedule 30-min legal Q&A (AE + SE + legal).
